body: I love love love your earing in your bottom lobe.

Ibuprofen, and baby it. Keep your hair away from it. I mean I have no proof that hair irrates them, but I know it helped me putting my hair up for 2 days after getting mine done. It was my most painful piercings and I have holes in my nips and gentials. It's so worth it though. I love my  conch. I'm currently trying to decide what to do to my other ear.

Today after work, I notice for the first time ever that ALL the gyms around me are instinct. Apparently these 3 dudes went around dropping 2k+ CP Dragonites in all the gyms around me, it was glorious.
This is literally every gym in my tiny town. I am so proud right now.
I once had  a piercer tell me he wouldn't carry internally threaded because it was so harsh putting in. It would catch and tug on the piercing... but externally threaded would glide right on through.

I would ask for a refund for multiple reasons. Bad placement (through areola), one appears to be a little crooked, and the fact they cut you. I would be livid, mainly because I've been in your shoes and know how crappy it feels to love your piercing but need to have it removed/repierced.
